days.title: 下龙 – 上平辽
days.morning: About 4 – 5 hours by car from Hanoi or Ha Long via Tien Yen.
days.afternoon: Check in in Binh Lieu town and stroll the market street.
days.evening: Stir-fried arrowroot noodles and chicken boiled with lime leaves.

days.title: 恐龙脊背
days.morning: Walk the patrol road over the winding grassy hills.
days.afternoon: Climb the stone steps to border marker 1300 for views over the border.

days.title: 溪纹瀑布 – 瑶族村寨
days.morning: Multi-tiered Khe Van waterfall in the forest – swim in the stream.
days.afternoon: Visit a Dao Thanh Phan village and watch costume embroidery.
days.evening: Smoked buffalo and corn wine by the kitchen fire.

days.title: 集市日 – 粉丝村
days.afternoon: Watch arrowroot noodles being made in Dong Van – Hoanh Mo and buy some to take home.

days.title: 返回下龙 – 河内
days.morning: Rice-roll breakfast, then leave Binh Lieu.
days.afternoon: Stop in Tien Yen for its famous chicken, then on to Ha Long or Hanoi.
